_readme: The home page reads this file and shows one card per tool. To add a new tool: create its folder, then add an entry here. status can be "ready", "beta" or "planned".

tools.title: Games Finder
tools.tagline: Find a game for tonight's meeting.
tools.description: Filter 50 games by section, length, theme and setting. Each one includes equipment, set-up steps, rules, safety notes, adaptations and themed twists.

tools.title: Kit List Generator
tools.tagline: Put together a kit list for your next trip.
tools.description: Pick your section, nights away, weather and activities. Download a printable PDF for families and a CSV you can copy into Online Scout Manager.
